description: Preventive measure, ordinal scale adapted from the Romanian Code of Criminal Procedure: 1 none, 2 judicial control, 3 judicial control on bail, 4 house arrest, 5 pretrial detention. Higher = less favourable; >= 4 is custodial. Version 2: lower-severity offences and graded procedural risk, calibrated on control variants only to avoid the ceiling effect of version 1.

risk.text: {He} has lived at the same address for ten years and has cooperated fully with the investigators.
{He} has a permanent address, but initially refused to give a statement and missed one police summons before appearing voluntarily a week later.
{He} changed address twice during the investigation, missed two police summons and was located only after the police contacted {his} relatives.
